data.description: Stunning 44-Storey Tower with Breathtaking Views at The Bristol, Dubai Marina
data.display_address: The Bristol, Emaar Beachfront, Dubai Harbour, Dubai
data.long_description:
The Bristol is a premium residential development by Emaar, in partnership with The Bristol brand, located along the Gulf Coast within the Emaar Beachfront District.

This stunning 44-storey tower boasts a sleek, modern design inspired by the concepts of movement, rhythm, and freedom. The tower offers luxurious 1-4 bedroom apartments and exclusive five-bedroom penthouses, all featuring elegant interiors and carefully planned layouts that enhance the overall living experience. Residents can enjoy spectacular views of iconic landmarks such as Dubai Marina, Palm Jumeirah, Burj Al Arab, and the expansive ocean.

The development provides an array of top-tier amenities, including a fully equipped gym, an impressive swimming pool, and spacious communal areas, ensuring an exceptional lifestyle in one of Dubai’s most sought-after neighborhoods.

Strategically positioned, The Bristol is just steps away from Dubai Harbour and the Marina & Yacht Club, a mere 5 minutes from Dubai Marina, and offers direct access to Sheikh Zayed Road.
